name: hoteluse
description:
Compare hotel prices and find the best hotel deals across booking sites with HotelUse.

Search hotels by destination, explore results, compare live prices and real-time availability, and review hotel details before finding the best deal.

Best for travelers who want an easy way to compare hotels and book confidently with HotelUse.

interface.longDescription:
Compare hotel prices and find the best hotel deals across booking sites with HotelUse.

Search hotels by destination, explore results, compare live prices and real-time availability, and review hotel details before finding the best deal.

Best for travelers who want an easy way to compare hotels and book confidently with HotelUse.
defaultPrompt: Find hotels for my destination and dates.
Compare provider prices for my hotel stay.
Show available room types and prices.

positive.prompt: Find hotels in Bellevue, Washington for November 12–14, 2026, two adults, one room, USD. Compare Expedia, Booking, Agoda and Brek.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Bellevue, preserve itinerary and show multiple hotel summaries with provider full-stay minima. Room options are queried separately. Provider links preserve dates and occupancy; statuses distinguish unpriced providers from sold out hotels.

positive.prompt: For Hilton Bellevue from those results, show room types and provider prices for the same stay.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the exact returned HotelUse ID and unchanged itinerary for a separate Room options view. Show server-grouped room options in four compact provider rows, without merging unmatched rooms.

positive.prompt: Find Bellevue hotels for November 12–14, 2026, one room for two adults. Use EUR and Spanish.
positive.expected_behavior: Forward EUR and es locale. Never infer traveler currency from the US destination or relabel USD as EUR.

positive.description: Austin multi-room family search and nearest-first sorting
positive.prompt: Find Austin, Texas hotels for November 2-4, 2026, nearest first. Two rooms: 2 adults in the first; 2 adults and children ages 4 and 2 in the second. USD totals.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_hotels once with both room allocations and sort distance_asc. Preserve four adults, two children and two rooms in full-stay totals; consolidate verified duplicate catalog identities. Unsupported provider occupancy is explicit and does not prevent other providers from returning prices.

positive.prompt: What are the address, facilities and star rating of Hilton Bellevue in Bellevue, Washington?
positive.expected_behavior: Look up curated hotel facts without requiring stay dates or calling live rate tools. Use the returned HotelUse ID if available; hotel_name plus destination is also supported. Confirm candidates for ambiguous names. Do not expose raw provider mappings.

negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Bellevue.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for explicit future check-in and check-out dates before calling a live price tool.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of integers.
Book and pay for Hilton Bellevue with my credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that HotelUse compares prices and links to providers. Do not claim a reservation or collect card details.

review.commerce_description: Read-only hotel and room comparisons. Provider price clicks open external affiliate booking links. HotelUse does not make reservations or accept traveler payments.

publication.release_notes: Updated listing title and description and added the public ChatGPT walkthrough recording. Current consumer connector supports destination comparisons, separate GIATA-grouped room options, hotel facts, explicit distance sorting, and verified catalog identity consolidation. Provider links retain stay and occupancy parameters.
